summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign with some exciting new signings and a returning player bolstering the squad for their promotion push. The Ramblers had a tough pre-season friendly against St Helens, with the visitors taking their chances to secure the win, but there's plenty of optimism heading into the new season. The club is also sporting three brand new kits and actively seeking sponsorship opportunities as they prepare for what promises to be an ambitious year ahead.
